spec.prompt:
Generate a production SPRITE SHEET for a small original 2D human village / family inheritance / tower-defense game. A genuine transparent RGBA background, not a checkerboard drawing. Cozy Chinese countryside-inspired pixel-art style, top-down three-quarter view facing down, warm ochre thatch, terracotta, muted forest/olive greens, cream, dark brown outlines. Clear chunky pixel clusters, restrained flat colors and tiny highlights, no photorealism, no 3D, no fine noise, no glossy gradients. The final sprites are small mobile-game assets so prioritize strong readable silhouettes. No text, numbers, labels, grid lines, UI scene, watermark or ground landscape. Each cell contains exactly ONE isolated requested sprite. Strict uniform grid aligned to the full canvas, equal square cells. Every sprite must have generous TRANSPARENT gutters of at least 15% of the cell width on all sides, including between adjacent sprites; never cross a cell boundary. Keep feet or object base at about 82% of cell height. No external shadow extending into the gutters.
Canvas aspect ratio 4:3, exactly FOUR columns and THREE rows = 12 cells, in this exact left-to-right row-major order:
Row 1: (1) small thatched cottage with simple wooden door; (2) a second small cottage of the same size with terracotta roof and round window, only a cosmetic variant; (3) small farm plot with two rows of ripe golden wheat and low fence; (4) compact lumber shed with stacked cut logs.
Row 2: (5) empty wooden arrow tower with small bow launcher, no human operator; (6) squat stone slingshot tower with wooden sling arm; (7) simple wood-and-stone slowing tower with a small pale-blue crystal; (8) empty circular stone tower foundation.
Row 3: (9) closed wooden village gate between two short log posts, a freestanding sprite; (10) the same village gate with a broken plank and small cracks but the exact same footprint, no rubble outside its cell; (11) small unlit stone-ring hearth with stacked logs; (12) the same hearth lit with a modest warm flame.
Cottages and towers use consistent scale. Gate may be wider but never exceeds 70% of its cell. No character in any sprite. Exactly twelve objects, no duplicated or missing cells.
